name: The Gentlemen
summary: The Gentlemen is a fast-rising RaaS operation launched by a former Qilin affiliate in mid-2025. It opened to affiliates in September 2025 and rapidly scaled to claim 328 victims in the first five months of 2026 — roughly 10% of all global ransomware claims. Its unusually high 90% affiliate cut has enabled aggressive recruitment. In early May 2026 the group suffered a backend infrastructure breach exposing internal chats, affiliate rosters, and ransom negotiation transcripts.

ttps.notes: Exposed FortiGate administrative accounts and VPN appliances primary vector
Modifies authentication and remote access protocol registry settings
Group Policy Management Console used to deploy malicious configurations domain-wide
Selective event log clearing observed post-intrusion
PsExec over SMB admin shares for lateral execution
SystemBC proxy malware — converts hosts to SOCKS5 relays
Strong per-file encryption with aggressive multi-vector self-propagation
Double extortion — exfiltration over encrypted channels before encryption

detection_opportunities: Alert on FortiGate admin account logins from new IPs or unusual geolocations
Detect Group Policy modifications by non-standard accounts
Alert on PowerShell Defender disabling commands
Detect NETLOGON share access followed by encryptor re-deployment
Monitor for Windows event log clearing
